themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, plan, and execute actions within research workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles discussing AI's ability to condense large amounts of text into concise summaries, often for research or meeting notes.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Highlights various AI tools designed to aid in different stages of the research process, from discovery to analysis.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Explores how AI can be integrated into the design process and enhance user research activities.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Discusses the effects of AI on jobs, skills, and the overall labor market, including potential displacement and new opportunities.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Focuses on the use of AI to automate software testing processes, improving efficiency and coverage.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Articles examining how AI influences job markets, hiring processes, and the employability of different demographics.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Covers the application of AI to gather, analyze, and derive actionable insights from customer data and feedback.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of artificial entities to simulate user behavior or data for testing and research purposes.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
